feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iterations 2 and 3 (16 mm contiguous at ±0.048 m, kp 5.0) removed line loss on the oval and s-bend, so sensing is no longer the limit there. They also gave identical s-bend results (progress 0.04, max_error 0.0611 m) at kp 5.0 both times, so gain is not the lever. Iteration 4 showed that the 20 mm pitch with 0.10 m track and 0.6 kg mass cut slalom progress from 0.104 to 0.035 and left s-bend progress at 0.04, so neither the wider pitch nor the narrower track/lighter mass is the fix. This candidate keeps the iteration 2 sensing and drivetrain and moves only the forward offset to y = 0.05 m. Decide the next step from the race result. If s-bend progress rises above 0.04 with oscillation below 0.16, keep y = 0.05 m and test a further lead. If s-bend progress is still 0.04 with y = 0.05 m, forward lead is not the fix, and the next lever is a larger lead or a drivetrain change. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.16 with no line loss, back off the lead toward y = 0.04 m.
